$comment: Machine-readable Sprint 4 plan. Prose rationale lives in specs/sprint-4-charter.md; this file is the shape delivery_loop_gate.py consumes. That script is NOT in this repo — it ships with the pm-skills plugin. Resolve it: PM_SCRIPTS=$(find ~/.claude/plugins -path '*/pm-skills/scripts' -type d -print -quit) then python3 "$PM_SCRIPTS/delivery_loop_gate.py" --plan specs/sprint-4-loop-plan.json --mode plan --output human. Sprint goal: M7 + M8 — write the agent bridge layer. Done = tests/smoke_test.tscn green with a real agent response in-engine. Bridge uses Claude Python SDK (not subprocess CLI). Auth: setup-token OAuth primary (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY fallback. D-029: bridge owns agent store at runtime, decoupled from submodule. Model band: opus-4-6 floor / opus-5 ceiling / fable by choice only. Reviewers: claude-review.yml + /codex adversarial + Adam.
goal: M7 + M8: write the agent bridge layer. Done when tests/smoke_test.tscn exits 0 with a real Claude agent response rendered in-engine via the typewriter effect. PLZG Sprint 4.

tasks.title: Fetch and reconcile against origin/dev before any other task runs
tasks.note: Blocking precondition, exempt from the attempt cap. No Jira ticket: it is a precondition the SessionStart hook already runs.

tasks.title: Sprint 4 charter (specs/sprint-4-charter.md), loop plan, D-029 in decision register, Jira sprint creation on PLZG board

acceptance.cmd: python3 scripts/validate_specs.py && test -f specs/sprint-4-charter.md && test -f specs/sprint-4-loop-plan.json

tasks.note: Charter, loop plan, and D-029 registration in one PR. Jira sprint 48 created on PLZG board 169 (company-managed Scrum). D-029: Bridge agent store — bridge maintains its own copy of agent definitions, decoupled from the submodule at runtime. Origin: docs/designs/platform-decisions.md.

tasks.title: bridge/bridge.py — WebSocket server + Claude SDK call (D-005, D-006, D-015)

acceptance.cmd: python3 -c "import bridge.bridge; print('import ok')" && python3 -m py_compile bridge/bridge.py

tasks.note: WebSocket server on localhost:8765 (D-015). Synchronous with timeout (D-006). Zero UI awareness (D-005) — swap test: replacing Godot with a CLI harness must require no bridge change. Uses anthropic Python SDK, bare Anthropic() constructor. Auth: setup-token OAuth primary (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY fallback. Standalone wscat/websocat test before Godot integration.

tasks.title: bridge/sync.py — sync module copies .md from submodule into bridge/agents/ (D-029)
tasks.note: D-029: reads claude-code-tresor/subagents/, writes to bridge/agents/. Runs explicitly (build step or manual), never at request time. Warns when submodule is missing or stale but never blocks the bridge. Handles missing submodule gracefully — exit with a clear error, not a stack trace.

tasks.title: bridge/agents.py — agent store loader, reads from bridge/agents/ at runtime (D-016)
tasks.note: Loads agent .md definitions from bridge/agents/ (D-029 store). Returns the definition as a string for use as system prompt. NPC scene stores agent_id only (D-016) — the loader resolves id to definition.

tasks.title: scenes/bridge/ws_client.gd — Godot WebSocket client (D-005 boundary)
tasks.note: Godot-side WebSocket client. D-005 boundary check: ws_client knows about WebSocket messages (JSON), never about agent definitions, auth, or the SDK. Emits signals that the dialogue panel consumes. D-025 for file layout.

tasks.title: Wire dialogue panel send → ws_client → bridge → response → typewriter (M8 integration, D-007)
tasks.note: M8 end-to-end: walk up to NPC → type question → real agent response appears with typewriter effect (D-007). Typewriter is frontend-only — bridge sends the full response, Godot reveals it character by character.

tasks.title: Smoke test update — assert real agent response (machine-checkable acceptance)
tasks.note: The sprint's terminal gate. Smoke test must assert that a real Claude response was received and rendered. Feel values asserted as bands, not equalities (existing convention). META-SPEC §5.8: machine-checkable acceptance means a gate went green, not that the work looked finished.

tasks.title: Sprint close — task-tracker update, CHANGELOG entry, charter close section
tasks.note: Procedural close. Update specs/task-tracker.md to check off M7 and M8. Add [Unreleased] CHANGELOG entry. Close the charter. Run delivery_loop_gate.py --mode close.
